import json
src='''def extract(g):
    import collections
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=set(); shapes=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j] and (i,j) not in seen:
                col=g[i][j]; st=[(i,j)]; seen.add((i,j)); cells=[]
                while st:
                    y,x=st.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and (ny,nx) not in seen and g[ny][nx]==col:
                            seen.add((ny,nx)); st.append((ny,nx))
                rs=[c[0] for c in cells]; cs=[c[1] for c in cells]
                r0,c0=min(rs),min(cs)
                sub=[[col if (r0+a,c0+b) in set(cells) else 0 for b in range(max(cs)-c0+1)] for a in range(max(rs)-r0+1)]
                shapes.append((c0,sub))
    shapes.sort()
    return [s[1] for s in shapes]

def transform(g):
    shapes=extract(g)
    out=[[0]*len(g[0]) for _ in range(len(g))]
    r=c=0
    for sh in shapes:
        h,w=len(sh),len(sh[0])
        for a in range(h):
            for b in range(w):
                if sh[a][b] and r+a<len(out) and c+b<len(out[0]):
                    out[r+a][c+b]=sh[a][b]
        r+=h-1; c+=w-1
    return out
'''
